name: 98038 · Maple Valley, WA
findings: ZIP 98038 (Maple Valley) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98038 (Maple Valley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98038 (Maple Valley) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
